releaseNotes: New Topics covered section collects weekly classwork and homework, with week/subject filters, resource links, offline saved data and Update now.
Topics checks default to Thursday 22:00 with a Friday 09:00 retry for an empty, unpublished or failed week. Days/times are configurable in Settings and use the parent's timezone.
Marks charts now use actual LMS Week 1/2/3 assessment groups rather than collection dates. Q1 Week 1 begins September 27, Week 2 October 4 and Week 3 October 11.
Missing scores remain gaps, saved content survives failed reads, and local settings, credentials, student history and resources are preserved.
